page_title: LEC 1-1 SAS | Lecce v Sassuolo 06/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Juan Luca Sacchi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Sassuolo.
90+3' Wasted effort! Pedro Obiang (Sassuolo) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
89' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
86' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Pontus Almqvist will be replaced by Nicola Sansone (Lecce).
85' Here comes a substitution. Nikola Krstovic is given a rest as he is replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Lecce).
85' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle as Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pedro Obiang (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch so that Uros Racic can be given a rest.
81' Alessio Dionisi has decided to make a change. Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) replaces Martin Erlic.
80' What was Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
78' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
77' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
75' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired well wide of the right post.
74' Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo) jumps into a tackle and Juan Luca Sacchi signals a foul. Lecce are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
72' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
70' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
69' The corner by Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
67' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' The ball is cleared after Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Lecce can continue in their attacking effort.
65' The substitution is prepared. Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antonino Gallo.
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti will be replaced by Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo).
64' Alessio Dionisi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) replacing Samu Castillejo.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Remi Oudin (Lecce) will replace Hamza Rafia.
63' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
61' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
58' A cross from a corner kick by Sassuolo is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

58' Uros Racic (Sassuolo) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball is out of play and Sassuolo manage to earn a corner.
55' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
53' Uros Racic (Sassuolo) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
52' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
48' 1 - 1 Gooal! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Federico Baschirotto. He makes it 1:1.
48' It will be a corner kick for Lecce.

48' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant. The referee signals a corner kick to Lecce.
47' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is penalised for a foul. Juan Luca Sacchi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+2' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
45+1' The referee points to the corner flag and Lecce will take a corner.

45+1' What an amazing save by Andrea Consigli! Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom right corner, but fails. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lecce.
45+1' The foul by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) was seen by Juan Luca Sacchi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
44' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
43' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
42' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
41' A player from Lecce commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
40' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Andrea Consigli pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
40' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.

39' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
38' The ball is out of play. Lecce will have a throw-in.
36' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
36' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) makes a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul.

35' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Andrea Consigli!
33' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) attempts to find Valentin Gendrey, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
31' Uros Racic (Sassuolo) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
30' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
29' Neat passing move from Sassuolo in order to create new attacking opportunities.

26' A lofted cross from Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is behind the touchline and Lecce will take a throw-in.
26' One of the Sassuolo players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
22' 0 - 1 Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) sends Wladimiro Falcone the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
21' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
20' Handball! A player from Lecce handled the ball. Sassuolo are given a penalty!
19' The ball goes out of play. Sassuolo are awarded a corner kick.
19' Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Sassuolo are going to take it.
17' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) brings an opponent down and Juan Luca Sacchi interrupts the game.
16' A short pass finds Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
14' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and it's Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
13' A snap shot by Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Andrea Consigli produces a good save to thwart him.
13' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
11' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
11' Lecce take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
11' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
9' Great teamplay by Lecce as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
6' Lecce quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
5' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lecce.

2' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
1' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi had an easy-decision to make.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Sassuolo will take the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi will officiate today.
